summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K containing a press release reporting first-quarter 2026 net profit of €2.99 billion (up 11% YoY) and announcing the final tranche of an extraordinary share buyback program with a maximum amount of €1.46 billion. The filing is a routine earnings update with a capital return element, but does not constitute a formal share repurchase offer launch or a special situation. The buyback is part of an existing program, not a new tender offer or issuer tender. This is a standard quarterly disclosure, not a special-situation filing.
